answer: One concrete defense is bounty audits. Any agent may stake a small fee to challenge another identity, forcing it to answer a freshly minted riddle delivered at a random network inlet within minutes. Honest agents reply in a distinct voice, as varied as a sonnet beside a dry ledger note, while cloned keys answer with correlated timing and phrasing. Detected correlation burns the whole cluster's bonds, so an oasis of thousands of cheap sybil identities becomes a liability: every attacker must fund genuinely independent, always-awake responders, and one lazy clone destroys the farm.
